$Comment: How credit for a fight is shared out when no narrower rule matches its subject. Four counters
are kept per participant while the fight is on: damage dealt to the boss, damage taken while a
member, seconds spent as a member, and damage dealt to the fight's adds (whatever its own
spawners raise, never the boss). Each weight below says what one unit of that counter is
worth; a participant's score is the weighted sum, and their share is that score against the top
contributor's, so the player who did most reads 1.0 and the rest a fraction of it. Loot rolls
are kept with a chance equal to the share, and a share under MinShare is credited with the
attempt but paid nothing. DamageToAdds is 0 here, so fighting the adds earns nothing unless a
narrower rule or a fight's own binding row weighs it.
A weight can be a bare number, as here, or a factor formula read about each participant, e.g.
Presence only accrues on a script whose Player sensor carries the EncounterMembers collector.
Match is a name pattern on the boss's mob id and Where the shared world selector, so a pack
ships a narrower rule beside this one ("Match": "*Warden*") without touching this file; the
most specific match wins. Retune this file for the whole server from
